title: Renewal Tactical Labyrinth — Q4 2027 pipeline tracker (working)
content:
Sheet title: Renewal Tactical Labyrinth — Q4 2027
Purpose: working tracker + quick-play cheat sheet for high-friction renewals. Use this as the canonical short-term view for next 30/60/90 day plays; separate canonical forecast lives in Forecast Master.

Columns (top row):
Account, Customer Owner, ARR (USD), Contract Start, Contract End, Term (months), Renewal Window (days), Renewal Probability (%), Weighted ARR, Last Contact, Next Step, Next Step Owner, Escalation Flag, Risk Notes, Expansion Upside (USD), Legal/Procurement Status, Required Internal Approvals, Confidence (1-5), Tags

Data rows (examples / working rows):
Acme Dataworks, Khari Malik, 120000, 2024-11-01, 2027-11-01, 36, 30, 55, 66000, 2027-09-20, Schedule exec briefing + ROI deck, Khari Malik, HIGH, Exec sponsor unclear; procurement slow, 20000, NDA pending, VP Sales signoff needed, 3, mid-market;growth
Nimbus Retail, Priya Nair, 45000, 2025-05-15, 2027-12-03, 31, 60, 85, 38250, 2027-10-01, Finalize discount SOW; send updated invoice, Priya Nair, MED, Support SLAs noted but ok, 5000, Contract addendum ready, Legal review queued, 4, renew-fast;support-important
Zenith Health, Marisol Chen, 310000, 2026-10-01, 2027-11-25, 13, 20, 30, 93000, 2027-10-03, Book compliance & data residency check, Marisol Chen, HIGH, HITRUST questions unresolved; potential migration, 0, Privacy addendum required, Escalate to Solutions Eng, 2, enterprise;regulatory
BrightLeaf Ed, Ethan Park, 75000, 2024-12-10, 2027-12-10, 36, 45, 70, 52500, 2027-09-28, Propose 12-month pilot + usage cap, Ethan Park, LOW, Low product usage; opportunity to upsell analytics, 15000, Standard T&Cs ok, Customer success playbook to run, 3, upsell;pilot

Calculated fields / usage notes: 
- Weighted ARR = ARR * (Renewal Probability / 100) — used to compute short-term revenue coverage.
- Renewal Window (days) flags accounts where Contract End - today <= Renewal Window => action escalated.
- Confidence field (1-5) is qualitative (5 = locked in, 1 = rescue territory).
- Escalation Flag: HIGH/MED/LOW based on risk_notes + legal status + exec alignment.

Summary rollups (manual pivot snapshot - update weekly):
- Total ARR in sheet: 545000
- Total Weighted ARR (sum of Weighted ARR): 254750
- ARR in next 30 days (contracts ending within 30 days): 430000 (Acme + Zenith)
- Forecast coverage (weighted) vs target net ARR to hit quota (example): weighted coverage = 47% of Q4 net renewal target (manual reference to Forecast Master required).

Risk signal taxonomy (quick reference):
- Legal delay: procurement or NDA outstanding > 14 days -> treat as MED/HIGH risk.
- Usage drop: product MAU or seats down > 25% QoQ -> treat as MED risk and schedule health check.
- Exec sponsor churn: sponsor left within 6 months -> HIGH risk and requires AE + CS skin-in-the-game.
- Price pushback: asks for >20% off list -> flag for discount review; require RevOps approval if >10%.

Playbook snippets (copy-paste quick actions):
- Rescue: Schedule 30-min health + ROI session within 5 business days; draft 2 concession options (term extension, usage credit) and submit to RevOps.
- Lock: Send signed SOW + invoice within 48 hours; CC Finance and set renewal date & gating tasks in Gainsight.
- Expand: Prepare 6-week analytics pilot + target 20% ARR upside; assign Solutions Eng and set success criteria.

Action items (current sprint):
- Khari: Prep exec ROI deck and confirm sponsor list; due 2027-10-14.
- Priya: Finalize discount SOW and attach updated T&Cs; due 2027-10-09.
- Marisol: Run privacy checklist with Legal; escalate if HITRUST gaps > 0; due 2027-10-11.
- Ethan: Book product adoption workshop and produce usage report; due 2027-10-08.

Notes / open questions: 
- Do we allow 12-month pilot discounts to stack with prepay offers? (status: policy question for RevOps).
- Should we move accounts with Confidence <=2 into dedicated rescue board? (proposal: yes; action: CS manager vote).

Versioning / provenance:
- This is a working sheet intended for short-term plays. Authoritative forecast numbers live in: CONFLUENCE:CS/renewal-forecast-master-2027.
- Changes tracked in Slack thread: #cs-renewals-thread-2027-10 — please annotate row-level changes with timestamps when possible.

Quick keyboard of filters to use:
- Filter by Escalation Flag=HIGH and Confidence<=3 for urgent triage.
- Filter by Renewal Window<=30 and Renewal Probability < 60 for rescue queue.
- Filter by Expansion Upside > 10000 for AE upsell outreach.

End of sheet (lightweight checklist):
- [ ] Weekly sync scheduled (Mon 10:00 PT)
- [ ] Export to Forecast Master on Fridays
- [ ] Update linked Jira tickets for escalations

Author note (Asha): this layout is intentionally compact for quick ops huddles; prefer to keep only top 3 fields editable by CSMs (Probability, Next Step, Last Contact) to reduce churn.
